title: IIoT 全系統視覺化戰情室

list.name: lookback
list.label: 曾觸發回看範圍（區①閃爍）
list.description: 狀態矩陣判定「曾經觸發過」要回看多久。超過這個時間沒再觸發，燈號才會自動轉綠。建議設成一個班別的長度。

panels.title: ① 設備即時狀態矩陣　—　全機台燈號（曾觸發過異常者，即使已恢復仍會閃爍提示，需人工確認才復歸）
機台狀態燈號矩陣（SCT-01 ~ SCT-10）
panels.description: 綠=正常；橘/紅實心=現在正在告警；閃爍的橘/紅=$lookback 內曾觸發過但現況已恢復，提示作業人員確認（避免自我復原的間歇性故障被無聲略過）。超過回看範圍沒再觸發就自動轉綠，回看範圍可用上方「曾觸發回看範圍」調整。告警來源涵蓋頻譜 SVM 異常、CUSUM 漸進劣化、三種 RUL、振動時域跳線。

targets.rawSql:
-- 純查詢版：不需要任何後端狀態表，全部從既有的偵測結果表即時算出來。
-- 燈號碼：0=正常 1=警告中 2=危險中 3/13=曾警告(閃爍) 4/14=曾危險(閃爍)
-- 閃爍：以 10 秒為週期取前後半段給不同顏色碼；儀表板 5 秒刷新一次，剛好每次落在相反半段而交替。
WITH ev AS (
  -- 來源①：頻譜 SVM 瞬時異常 + CUSUM 漸進劣化
  SELECT device_id, ts, 1 AS sev
  FROM anomaly_scores
  WHERE (is_anomaly OR COALESCE(cusum_alarm, false))
    AND ts > now() - INTERVAL '$lookback'
  UNION ALL
  -- 來源②：三種 RUL + 時域跳線（都寫在 rul_predictions，用 status 分級）
  SELECT device_id, ts, CASE status WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
  FROM rul_predictions
  WHERE status IN ('WARNING','CRITICAL')
    AND ts > now() - INTERVAL '$lookback'
  UNION ALL
  -- 來源③：振動跳線閂鎖只要還鎖著，就算現在仍是 CRITICAL（災難兜底的安全語意）
  SELECT device_id, now(), 2 FROM vib_trip_latches
),
agg AS (
  SELECT device_id,
         max(sev) FILTER (WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL '2 minutes') AS sev_now,
         max(sev) AS sev_hist
  FROM ev GROUP BY device_id
),
s AS (
  SELECT m.device_id,
         CASE
           WHEN COALESCE(a.sev_now, 0) = 2 THEN 2
           WHEN COALESCE(a.sev_now, 0) = 1 THEN 1
           WHEN COALESCE(a.sev_hist, 0) = 2
             THEN CASE WHEN (extract(epoch FROM now())::int % 10) < 5 THEN 4 ELSE 14 END
           WHEN COALESCE(a.sev_hist, 0) = 1
             THEN CASE WHEN (extract(epoch FROM now())::int % 10) < 5 THEN 3 ELSE 13 END
           ELSE 0
         END AS code
  FROM machine_vibration_thresholds m
  LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.device_id = m.device_id
)
SELECT
  max(code) FILTER (WHERE device_id='SCT-01') AS "SCT-01",
  max(code) FILTER (WHERE device_id='SCT-02') AS "SCT-02",
  max(code) FILTER (WHERE device_id='SCT-03') AS "SCT-03",
  max(code) FILTER (WHERE device_id='SCT-04') AS "SCT-04",
  max(code) FILTER (WHERE device_id='SCT-05') AS "SCT-05",
  max(code) FILTER (WHERE device_id='SCT-06') AS "SCT-06",
  max(code) FILTER (WHERE device_id='SCT-07') AS "SCT-07",
  max(code) FILTER (WHERE device_id='SCT-08') AS "SCT-08",
  max(code) FILTER (WHERE device_id='SCT-09') AS "SCT-09",
  max(code) FILTER (WHERE device_id='SCT-10') AS "SCT-10"
FROM s

panels.title: 需注意機台
panels.description: 現在正在告警、或 $lookback 內曾觸發過的機台數。只要 > 0 就代表有事件需要作業人員確認。

targets.rawSql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT device_id FROM anomaly_scores
  WHERE (is_anomaly OR COALESCE(cusum_alarm,false)) AND ts > now() - INTERVAL '$lookback'
  UNION
  SELECT device_id FROM rul_predictions
  WHERE status IN ('WARNING','CRITICAL') AND ts > now() - INTERVAL '$lookback'
  UNION
  SELECT device_id FROM vib_trip_latches
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT device_id) AS "需注意機台數" FROM ev

panels.title: 告警明細（$lookback 內）
panels.description: 現況欄：『告警中』=最近 2 分鐘仍在觸發；『已恢復』=現況正常但回看範圍內曾觸發過，燈號會閃爍提示確認，超過回看範圍沒再觸發就自動轉綠。觸發來源欄可看出是哪一層偵測器抓到的。

targets.rawSql:
-- 純查詢版：來源與燈號矩陣相同，只是多帶出「是哪一層偵測器、什麼時候」
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT device_id, ts, 1 AS sev,
         CASE WHEN COALESCE(cusum_alarm,false) THEN 'CUSUM漸進劣化' ELSE '頻譜異常' END AS src
  FROM anomaly_scores
  WHERE (is_anomaly OR COALESCE(cusum_alarm,false)) AND ts > now() - INTERVAL '$lookback'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT device_id, ts, CASE status WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
         CASE metric_kind WHEN 'current_mean' THEN '電流RUL' WHEN 'thd_ratio' THEN '頻譜RUL'
                          WHEN 'ml_rf' THEN 'ML RUL' WHEN 'vib_trip' THEN '時域跳線'
                          ELSE metric_kind END
  FROM rul_predictions
  WHERE status IN ('WARNING','CRITICAL') AND ts > now() - INTERVAL '$lookback'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT device_id, now(), 2, '時域跳線(閂鎖中)' FROM vib_trip_latches
)
SELECT device_id AS "機台",
       CASE max(sev) WHEN 2 THEN 'CRITICAL' ELSE 'WARNING' END AS "等級",
       string_agg(DISTINCT src, ', ' ORDER BY src) AS "觸發來源",
       CASE WHEN max(ts) > now() - INTERVAL '2 minutes' THEN '告警中' ELSE '已恢復' END AS "現況",
       min(ts) AS "首次觸發",
       max(ts) AS "最近觸發",
       count(*) AS "觸發次數"
FROM ev
GROUP BY device_id
ORDER BY max(sev) DESC, max(ts) DESC

panels.title: ② 各監控感應器現況趨勢（$device）　—　實際量測值，紅/黃/綠虛線為上下限
溫度 — $device
panels.description: 自然漂移應落在 25.5~26.5°C。紅虛線為上下限。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS "time", value AS "溫度"
FROM sensor_readings
WHERE device_id = '$device'
  AND sensor_id = 'T' || (split_part('$device','-',2))::int::text
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts

panels.title: 電流三相 (A/B/C) — $device
panels.description: 1 秒彙總後 60Hz 正弦波已被平均抵消，三相看起來接近是正常現象。紅虛線=電流 RUL 追蹤的上下限 5.5% / 6.5%。圖例可點擊單獨顯示某一相。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT bucket AS "time", sensor_id AS "metric", avg_value AS value
FROM current_1s_agg
WHERE device_id = '$device' AND $__timeFilter(bucket)
ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: 三軸合成振動 vs ISO 門檻 — $device
panels.description: 綠=優良上限、黃=可接受上限、紅=危險門檻（依機台 Class 自動對應：I=4.5、II=7.1、III=11.2 mm/s）。合成振動碰到紅線就會觸發時域跳線強制 CRITICAL。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  v.bucket AS "time",
  sqrt(v.x*v.x + v.y*v.y + v.z*v.z) AS "合成振動",
  t.good_upper AS "優良上限",
  t.acceptable_upper AS "可接受上限",
  t.danger_lower AS "危險門檻"
FROM vibration_1s_agg v
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT good_upper, acceptable_upper, danger_lower
  FROM machine_vibration_thresholds WHERE device_id = '$device'
) t
WHERE v.device_id = '$device' AND $__timeFilter(v.bucket)
ORDER BY v.bucket

panels.title: ③ 早期預警趨勢（$device）　—　振幅還看不出來時就會先動的指標，與區②的現況值分開呈現
頻譜劣化 thd_ratio — $device（三軸）
panels.description: 諧波/基頻能量比。真實軸承早期故障會先在頻譜出現邊帶，此值上升時整體振幅往往還沒動——這是比區②更早的預警。紅線=劣化門檻 0.05（健康約 0.005）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS "time", thd_ratio AS value, sensor_id AS metric
FROM anomaly_scores
WHERE device_id = '$device' AND sensor_id LIKE 'V%' AND thd_ratio IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts

panels.title: CUSUM 漸進劣化累積 — $device（三軸）
panels.description: 累積「異常分數持續系統性下滑」的量，而非看瞬時值是否低於某條線。持續走高代表偵測到漸進劣化。跨資料集驗證 32/32 真實軸承全命中。決策門檻 h 會從 8σ 衰減到 7σ 地板（依 ISA-18.2 告警率訂）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS "time", cusum AS value, sensor_id AS metric
FROM anomaly_scores
WHERE device_id = '$device' AND sensor_id LIKE 'V%' AND cusum IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts

panels.title: 振動 ML 剩餘壽命 + 信賴區間 — $device（X 軸）
panels.description: RandomForest（32 顆真實軸承訓練、跨 IMS 泛化驗證）輸出的剩餘壽命。實線=點估計，虛線=P10(悲觀)/P90(樂觀) 信賴區間（ISO 13381-1 要求預後須附信賴區間）。實測相對誤差 60~70%，區間寬度就是這個不確定性——請依 P10 安排保養，不要咬住點估計。橘線=200分(WARNING)、紅線=60分(CRITICAL)。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS "time",
       eta_p10_seconds/60.0 AS "P10(悲觀)",
       eta_seconds/60.0 AS "點估計",
       eta_p90_seconds/60.0 AS "P90(樂觀)"
FROM rul_predictions
WHERE device_id = '$device' AND metric_kind = 'ml_rf' AND eta_seconds IS NOT NULL
  AND sensor_id LIKE '%-X'
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts

panels.title: 振動 rms_norm（現值 / 健康基線）— $device（三軸）
panels.description: ML RUL 最重要的輸入特徵（重要度 57%）。1.0=與健康基線相同；真實軸承磨損末期可達 6~10 倍。持續走高代表振幅型劣化正在發生。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS "time", current_mean AS value, sensor_id AS metric
FROM rul_predictions
WHERE device_id = '$device' AND metric_kind = 'ml_rf' AND current_mean IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts

panels.title: 三種 RUL 預測總表（全機隊，依緊急程度排序）
panels.description: 電流均值 RUL＝追蹤電流均值撞上下限；頻譜 RUL＝追蹤 thd_ratio 撞 0.05；ML RUL＝RandomForest 直接輸出剩餘分鐘（附 P10/P90 信賴區間）。三者互補：前兩者是趨勢外推，ML 是從真實軸承學來的。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE metric_kind WHEN 'current_mean' THEN '電流均值 RUL'
                   WHEN 'thd_ratio'    THEN '頻譜 RUL'
                   WHEN 'ml_rf'        THEN 'ML RUL (RF)'
                   ELSE metric_kind END AS "預測種類",
  device_id AS "機台", sensor_id AS "感測器",
  round(current_mean::numeric, 4) AS "追蹤量現值",
  round((eta_p10_seconds/60)::numeric, 0) AS "P10(悲觀)",
  round((eta_seconds/60)::numeric, 0) AS "剩餘(分)",
  round((eta_p90_seconds/60)::numeric, 0) AS "P90(樂觀)",
  status AS "狀態"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id, sensor_id, metric_kind)
    device_id, sensor_id, metric_kind, current_mean, eta_seconds,
    eta_p10_seconds, eta_p90_seconds, status, ts
  FROM rul_predictions
  WHERE metric_kind IN ('current_mean','thd_ratio','ml_rf')
    AND ts > now() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  ORDER BY device_id, sensor_id, metric_kind, ts DESC
) latest
ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
         eta_seconds NULLS LAST

panels.title: ④ 異常警告歷史紀錄
全機隊告警時間軸（最近 24 小時，每點=一次偵測到異常）
panels.description: 把各偵測器的告警畫在同一條時間軸上，快速看出「什麼時候、哪一台、哪一種偵測器」在叫。值 2=CRITICAL、1=WARNING。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS "time",
       CASE status WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS value,
       device_id || ' / ' || CASE metric_kind
         WHEN 'current_mean' THEN '電流RUL' WHEN 'thd_ratio' THEN '頻譜RUL'
         WHEN 'ml_rf' THEN 'ML RUL' WHEN 'vib_trip' THEN '時域跳線'
         ELSE metric_kind END AS metric
FROM rul_predictions
WHERE status IN ('WARNING','CRITICAL') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts

panels.title: 異常事件明細（最近 24 小時，全機隊）
panels.description: 涵蓋頻譜 SVM 瞬時異常與 CUSUM 漸進劣化。『偵測器』欄可看出是哪一層抓到的：頻譜異常＝單一窗口的頻譜結構跑掉；CUSUM 劣化＝分數持續系統性下滑（更早、更可靠的漸進劣化訊號）。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS "時間", device_id AS "機台", sensor_id AS "感測器",
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(cusum_alarm,false) THEN 'CUSUM 漸進劣化' ELSE '頻譜異常(瞬時)' END AS "偵測器",
       round(score::numeric,4) AS "SVM分數",
       round(thd_ratio::numeric,5) AS "thd_ratio",
       round(rms::numeric,3) AS "RMS"
FROM anomaly_scores
WHERE (is_anomaly OR COALESCE(cusum_alarm,false))
  AND ts > now() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: 振動時域跳閘紀錄（災難兜底，最近 24 小時）
panels.description: 三軸合成 RMS 超過 ISO 危險線就強制 CRITICAL，完全不看 AI 分數——這是學習型模型失效時的最後一道保險。閂鎖期間會持續寫入，所以同一次事件會有多筆連續紀錄。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS "時間", device_id AS "機台",
       current_mean AS "合成RMS", target_threshold AS "危險線", status AS "狀態"
FROM rul_predictions
WHERE metric_kind = 'vib_trip' AND ts > now() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: ⑤ 系統健康監控（edge_pipeline 進程）
CPU 使用率

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", cpu_percent AS "CPU%" FROM system_health WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: 記憶體使用量

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", memory_mb AS "RAM(MB)" FROM system_health WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: 每秒寫入吞吐量 (TPS)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", tps AS "TPS" FROM system_health WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: 資料庫寫入延遲

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", write_latency_ms AS "延遲(ms)" FROM system_health WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
